author: CBS 8
title: One hospitalized following officer-involved shooting in East Village - NewsBreak
text:
2 hours ago SAN DIEGO — An investigation into a shooting involving San Diego Police is underway in East Village on Wednesday afternoon. The shooting happened shortly after 5 p.m. at the intersection of Island Avenue and 16th Street. Witnesses told CBS 8 they saw a woman wielding either a knife or something resembling an ice pick, threatening another person on the sidewalk at the corner of that intersection. They say an officer, who was on patrol in East Village, approached the woman and ordered her to drop the weapon she was holding. Read full article
